draft.subject: your transport planner role
draft.body:
Hi Joanna,

Saw Fenmoor is hiring a transport planner to key collection requests from email into your TMS. Requests like that often get typed in twice.

We built a single operations platform covering CRM, orders, inventory, vendors and analytics for an automotive retail and services business. I've attached a one-page overview.

Worth a look?

evidence.text: Transport Planner / Dispatcher. Plan daily routes and key customer collection requests from email into our TMS.
